title: nrmlz config
description: Settings of the nrmlz command line ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nrmlz/config.toml or ./nrmlz.toml).

lexicon.description: Lexicon file (.toml, .json or .tsv) with terms to replace. Empty: no lexicon.

profile.description: nrmlz (default, all fixes) or reference (exactly the Articulino frontend); +fix/-fix terms allowed, e.g. reference+plain-decimal.

decimal_pause.description: Pause comma after Komma (drei Komma, fünf), for models trained on the Articulino frontend.

respellings.description: Apply the respelling entries of the abbreviation table (Homebrew -> Hohmbruh, OK -> okeh).

lexicon_stage.description: Apply the lexicon before normalisation (raw text) or after it (spoken form). A stage in the lexicon file wins.
